fauna: Small herbivorous pterosaur feeding on botanical growth
Insectivorous pterosaur snapping an insect out of mid-air
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; action-driven composition; clear cause-and-effect relationship; no text.

visual_logic.composition: The scene displays two distinct interactive feeding behaviors. ON THE LOWER LEFT: A small, specialized pterosaur is delicately plucking early seed-pods or proto-fruits directly from the low branches of a birch-like tree. ON THE UPPER RIGHT: A lush patch of Paleopus flowers has attracted a buzzing swarm of primitive lacewings and beetles. A quick, agile pterosaur is frozen mid-dive, its beak wide open as it snaps up an insect hovering right above the blossoms, clearly showing how the flora acts as an ecological magnet for its food source.
visual_logic.ground: Slippery, light-colored grey-green volcanic mud covered in fallen leaves.
visual_logic.background: Deep blue-green caldera lake visible through the dense hardwood tree trunks.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright afternoon sun filtered through thin leaves, casting warm highlights and dappled patterns across the foraging animals.
